sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: EPMC_FULLTEXT_MARKER This is a comprehensive study describing gene sequencing and mutation analysis in canine models. We performed genome-wide association studies and targeted resequencing across multiple pedigrees.

The investigation demonstrated clear phenotypic concordance with homozygous recessive inheritance patterns. Further cellular assays confirmed impaired trafficking of vacuolar protein sorting complexes.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Genomic DNA was extracted from whole blood samples using standard automated magnetic bead protocols. High-throughput sequencing libraries were prepared according to standard manufacturer guidelines and sequenced on an Illumina platform with paired-end 150bp reads.
